test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Opulent
solution:
The correct option is **"Destitute"** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **antonym** is a term that means the exact opposite of another word.
 
• Being **opulent** refers to having a lot of property, money, and stuff.
 
 
• ***Example:** All the money went for his **opulent** lifestyle.*
 
 
 
• **Destitute** means who has nothing or who has lost all his things.
 
 
• ***Example:** He became **destitute** because of his business failure.*
 
 
 
• So the absolute opposite meaning of **Opulent** is Destitute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the other options whether they are opposite of Opulent or not.
 
• Being **insolvent** refers to ceasing to make payments on obligations as they become due in the normal course of business.
 
• To **flourish** is to develop luxuriantly.
 
• If you're **depressed**, you feel down and unable to appreciate anything because your circumstances are so **unpleasant** and **challenging**.
 
• The rest of the above three options are not the correct **antonyms** of **Opulent**.
